openEditor: Sign in to build your CV
editorNote: The editor requires sign-in. Public page language, editor language, OCR and PDF heading options are separate; Polish public pages currently open the English editor.

home.title: Free CV builder with clean PDF downloads
home.description: Sign in to create a CV and download Color or Plain PDFs without a watermark. Learn the actual document-reading limits and checkout status.
home.h1: Build your CV, then download a clean PDF
home.intro: Use a structured profile to organize your experience, education and skills. The signed-in editor provides three templates and two free PDF styles.

sections.heading: Your details stay editable
sections.body: Review imported values before applying them. Missing details are requested rather than invented.

sections.heading: Understand the available tools
sections.body: Document reading extracts text and proposes profile fields. It is not verified generative resume writing, automatic job submission or a tool that writes back into every PDF.

templates.title: CV templates: Meridian, Consulate and Atlas
templates.description: Compare the three implemented CV layouts and free Color and Plain PDF styles. Choose based on the application instructions, not a promised ATS score.
templates.h1: Choose a CV layout for your application
templates.intro: Meridian, Consulate and Atlas are existing layouts in the editor. Keep the information accurate and follow the employer’s requested format.

sections.heading: Designed or plain
sections.body: Color PDF preserves the designed style. Plain PDF uses simple black-and-white styling with the same content and no watermark.

sections.heading: Check the exported file
sections.body: Open your PDF and inspect page breaks and characters before sending it. Unicode output across all languages has not yet been validated.

services.title: Free PDF downloads and paid-plan availability
services.description: Color and Plain PDFs are free after sign-in. Paid form-filler checkout is currently unavailable in the dated public status observation.
services.h1: What is free, and what is not ready?
services.intro: The current editor offers free Color PDF and Plain PDF downloads after sign-in, without a watermark. The free UI does not establish a free Word download.

sections.heading: Paid checkout is not ready
sections.body: Paid form-filler plans exist, but the public status observed on 7 November 2026 reported unavailable, trial mode enabled and no provider. Recheck availability before relying on a purchase.

sections.heading: No unlimited-use promise
sections.body: No numerical daily quota was found in the direct browser PDF path. This does not mean unlimited service; device resources, document limits and future reviewed policies may apply.

faq.title: Questions about free CV PDFs and document reading
faq.description: Answers about sign-in, watermark-free PDF downloads, English OCR, file limits and the current availability of paid form-filler checkout.
faq.h1: Know what the product can do
faq.intro: These answers describe implemented behavior and explicitly identify what has not been verified.

sections.heading: Before you start
sections.body: Use only details you intend to include in your CV. Review extracted suggestions and the final PDF.

sections.heading: Scope matters
sections.body: Website translations do not prove multilingual OCR, worldwide availability or support for every PDF character.

about.title: About formzolo and FormZalo
about.description: A factual overview of the existing formzolo CV builder, FormZalo domain, document-to-profile assistance and limits.
about.intro: The existing product uses the formzolo brand on the formzalo.com domain. FormZalo is also used as a project alias; these pages do not rename the editor.

sections.heading: Practical assistance
sections.body: The product organizes profile details, displays template previews and proposes fields from document text for user review. There is no verified active generative-model integration.

sections.heading: Clear boundaries
sections.body: We do not promise job offers, ATS scores, automatic applications, arbitrary PDF writeback, search rankings or AI recommendations.

help.title: Help: sign in, read a document and download a CV
help.description: Follow the existing sign-in and PDF workflow. Check the 12 MiB input limit, two-page scanned-PDF fallback and English OCR support.
help.h1: Prepare and check your CV step by step
help.intro: Open the editor, sign in, enter your details or read a supported document, review suggested values, then download Color PDF or Plain PDF.

sections.heading: Document reading limits
sections.body: PDF text, supported images and plain text are accepted. The input limit is 12 MiB; scanned-PDF OCR fallback reads at most two pages and initializes English OCR. Resources may need to download.

sections.heading: When results need correction
sections.body: Use a clearer image or text PDF, and correct the profile manually. Always check the downloaded file. Do not upload information that is unnecessary for your intended CV.

faq.question: Do I need to sign in?
faq.answer: Yes. The current editor and free download controls require sign-in.

faq.question: Are free PDF downloads watermarked?
faq.answer: No. Signed-in users can download Color PDF and Plain PDF without a watermark.

faq.question: Can I download free Word files or generate AI-written CV text?
faq.answer: The current free UI exposes PDF styles, not a free Word button. An active generative-model writing integration has not been verified.

faq.question: What are the reading limits?
faq.answer: Input files are limited to 12 MiB. Scanned-PDF fallback reads at most two pages; OCR initializes English only.

faq.question: Can I buy a form-filler plan now?
faq.answer: The public status observed on 7 November 2026 reported paid checkout unavailable, trial mode enabled and no payment provider. No successful live purchase is claimed.
